# db-24 — DataBall many-file opens must have a bad-file policy and an open report

`OpenOptions.OnBadFile` chooses how a bad file is handled:
- `Abort` (the default): the open throws, naming the file.
- `Skip`: the other files land, and `OpenReport.Skipped` lists the bad file with its message, plus row, column and value when the error carries them.

If every file is bad, `Skip` still throws. The CLI `import` takes several inputs, `--recursive` and `--skip-bad`.

**2026-10-11** — **2026-10-11** — From the db-11 relay (architect, 2026-10-11): (a) Open has two pipelines below the one entry: OpenOneAsync (pointer, native, Parquet view, single CSV/handler) and OpenManyAsync (staged). Shrink OpenOneAsync to pointer, native and Parquet view, and stage every other single source, so the bad-file policy and the Skipped report attach to one staging loop. (b) Metadata reconciliation now has three loops: ExtractConfiguredMetadata/ApplyMetadataAgainstSource (wide append), the PlanAppend loop (layout append) and ReconcileSourceMetadata (many-file open). Owner decision 7 keeps append demotion separate from the three levels for now; unify into one planner.

(b) The append backfill from source (BackfillFromSource) CASTs the source column type into the incoming row column type; decide the column type with DecideColumnMerge(sourceType, incomingType) and throw a named conflict instead of a wrapped DuckDB conversion error.

Added to db-24: a recursive glob skips files under stray directories (any path segment below the glob's directory starting with '.' or '_'), matching directory expansion; today globs are not stray-filtered, so '**'-style recursive '*.parquet' picks up _temporary/ files that directory expansion skips.

**2026-10-12** — **2026-10-12** — Owner decisions, db-24 spec review (2026-10-11): relay lite (Haiku 5.5 high implementer, Opus medium reviewer, Sonnet medium gate), landed. (1) Skip covers per-source failures before the merge: unreadable file, detection None/Ambiguous on a named file, CSV/Parquet parse error, handler throw, unreadable archive, within-file requireConstant. Cross-source merge conflicts (type conflict between files) still abort, naming both sources. (2) A bad archive entry skips only that entry (<archive>!<entry> in Skipped); an unreadable archive is skipped whole. (3) A named file that detects as no format is Skipped under Skip and throws under Abort; expanded files that detect as none stay in Ignored. (4) Skipped row/column/value are nullable and filled only from a structured exception (db-12's DataBallCastException); no parsing of DuckDB message text. (5) CLI import with one input and no --recursive/--skip-bad keeps today's path exactly; several inputs, a glob, --recursive or --skip-bad go through Open(inputs, OpenOptions). (6) CLI --append with more than one input or --recursive fails with a clear message until db-16. OpenReport.Sources stays OpenedSource(SourceInfo, Rows) from db-11, superseding the db-22 note.

## Why

Split out of db-11 on 2026-10-10. Owner decision (suite alignment doc): "Bad data across files: the caller chooses: abort everything, or skip the bad file and report file / row / column / value."

**Model note (owner, 2026-10-10):** Claude-only relay. Implementer: **Haiku 5.5, high**, a trial. The reviewer and architect models are set at relay start.
